results.title: Cloudflare: Build for the agent era
results.text:
# Cloudflare

> Deploy serverless code instantly across the globe with zero cold starts, infinite scalability, and integrated storage, AI, and network services.

## What is Cloudflare Workers?

Cloudflare Workers is a serverless platform that runs your code on Cloudflare's global network of 330+ data centers. Unlike traditional serverless platforms that use containers, Workers uses V8 isolates for instant startup times with no cold starts.

## Key Features

- Zero Cold Starts: Code starts executing immediately using V8 isolates
- Global by Default: Deploy once, run in 330+ cities worldwide
- Multiple Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and WASM
- Integrated Platform: Storage (R2, D1, KV), AI (Workers AI), and network services built-in
- Pay for What You Use: CPU-time based billing, not wall-clock time

## Products

### Compute

- Workers: Global serverless functions
- Containers: Any language, anywhere
- Durable Objects: Stateful compute
- Browser Rendering: Automated browsers
- Workflows: Process orchestration

### Storage

- R2: Egress-free object storage
- Hyperdrive: Global database acceleration
- D1: Serverless SQL
- KV: Key-value storage
- Queues: Message processing

### AI

- Workers AI: Edge AI models
- AI Gateway: AI observability
- Vectorize: Vector database
- AI Search: Instant retrieval

### Media

- Images: Image optimization
- Stream: Video streaming
- RealtimeKit: Live communications

### Network

- DNS: Fast DNS
- CDN: Content delivery
- WAF: Application protection
- Load Balancing: Zero downtime
- Rate Limiting: Abuse prevention
- Bot Mitigation: Block bots

## Getting Started

1. Sign up at dash.cloudflare.com
2. Install the CLI: `npm install -g wrangler`
3. Create a project: `wrangler init my-worker`
4. Deploy: `wrangler deploy`

## Resources

- Documentation: Full technical docs
- Pricing: See what it costs
- Discord: Community support

---

# Snyk AI Security Platform

Security at machine speed.

Discover our plans Book a live demo

Your browser does not support the video tag.

## The Snyk AI Security Platform

Snyk’s AI-native and agentic platform helps organizations secure and govern development to unleash productivity, reduce business risk, and accelerate software delivery for the age of AI.

The Snyk AI Security Platform provides an independent validation layer for AI-built software. It separates the validator from the generator: deterministic engines paired with frontier-model reasoning validate the code AI writes, the models and agents it runs, and the applications it builds instead of trusting the system that produced them to grade its own work.

## Evo Agent Security

AI-native security orchestration — securing the code AI writes, the models and agents it runs, and the applications it builds.

Secure the AI workforce powering modern development

## Agentic Development Security (ADS)

Govern what agents use, what they do, and what they generate by validating external tools before they are used, governing agent behavior during execution, and securing code at the moment it is created.

Total visibility and machine-speed governance for AI applications

## AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM)

The centralized command center for your AI security posture. Replace manual reviews with automated, code-first governance that turns business intent into enforceable guardrails.

Proactive defense through AI-native simulation

## Continuous Offensive Security (COS)

Find the architectural flaws and chained business-logic vulnerabilities that are hard to detect with traditional scanners with AI Pentesting and Red Teaming — before attackers exploit them.

In AI security, detection was never the bottleneck. By pairing Claude's capabilities with Snyk, enterprises can turn high-fidelity findings into action inside the workflows where software is built.

Jason Clinton

Deputy CISO, Anthropic

## Security engines powering deterministic validation

A new generation of builders — humans, models, and autonomous agents — now creates software together. When creation accelerates beyond human speed, risk accelerates with it. Even the most capable model in the world cannot be trusted to govern its own cybersecurity output at scale. Snyk's AI Security Platform uses a mix of proprietary security engines, self-hosted models, and third-party frontier models through secure connections.

### Deterministic validation

Snyk pairs frontier-model reasoning with deterministic engines and a decade of curated security intelligence to give AI-generated code the confidence, repeatability, and governance enterprises need.

### Cross-tool governance

Developers use a stack of AI tools and coding agents — Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Windsurf. Anthropic only governs Claude; OpenAI only governs its own. The generator cannot be the validator. Snyk validates across the entire coding agent stack — so no vendor grading its own output.

### Security intelligence flywheel

Snyk uses frontier models to find novel vulnerability patterns, then backports those findings into its deterministic engines. Customers get frontier-quality detections at deterministic speed.

### Improved outcomes for AI fixes

Snyk adds its security intelligence on top. On its own, Claude Sonnet 4.6 produces a secure and functional fix ~72% of the time; with Snyk intelligence layered on, that "merge-ready" rate climbs to ~82% inside Snyk Agent Fix.

## The prescriptive path to operationalize AI security

Bridge the gap between developer velocity and security governance with a defined, 6-step path to operationalize security at machine speed.

## Stabilize by eliminating blind spots and stopping the bleeding

Step 1: Foundational visibility

Automatically discover and inventory every asset—including code, dependencies, and AI models.

Step 2: Prevention and AI guardrails

Enforce 'Secure at Inception' guardrails across AI assistants, IDEs, and pipelines to prevent vulnerabilities before they enter the codebase.

## Optimize by focusing on what matters and fixing at machine speed

Step 3: Strategic prioritization

Pinpoint exploitable risks using deep application intelligence, risk scores, and reachability analysis to focus on what truly threatens the business.

Step 4: AI-accelerated remediation

Empower developers with trusted, AI-powered "one-click" fixes directly in the IDE and pull request to dramatically accelerate the fix rate and burn down your security debt.

## Scale the program and deploy autonomous defense

Step 5: Governance and measurement

Sustain the program with automated policy enforcement and actionable analytics to track risk reduction, developer adoption, and prove ROI.

Step 6: Agentic orchestration

Deploy Evo, the agentic security orchestrator, to future-proof your defense and provide autonomous, runtime protection for non-deterministic AI-native applications.

## Future-proof your AI transformation

Every company is moving toward AI, and security has to move with it. Snyk is ready to support our AI initiatives by protecting us as we adopt and experiment with AI. That's exactly the kind of partner we want for this next phase.

Leon Direito

CISO, Yalo

Every organization building with AI needs to answer this one question. Get started with Snyk in minutes.

## See what customers are saying

### How Turing expedites payments for 6,000+ global workers with Deel

## FAQs

### What is Deel Payroll?

Deel Payroll is a single platform to run payroll for employees and contractors across countries. You can run payroll yourself or have Deel manage it—with unified data, built-in compliance, and global payments in one system.

### Can I run payroll myself or have Deel manage it?

Yes. Deel supports both models:

- Self-serve payroll for teams with in-house expertise
- Managed payroll where Deel runs payroll end to end You can choose the model per country and mix both as you scale.

### How are my payments handled?

Approve payroll once and Deel manages FX, local payments rails, and multi-currency payouts with optional crypto payouts where supported.

### Do I need to replace my current payroll provider everywhere?

No. Many teams start with one country or entity and expand over time. With Payroll Connect, you can view Deel-run payroll and third-party payrolls side by side in one dashboard during transitions.

### What worker types does Deel Payroll support?

Employees, contractors, EOR, and PEO—all visible in one platform with consolidated reporting.

### How does Deel handle compliance?

Local tax rules, statutory requirements, and filings are applied automatically before payroll runs. Built-in intelligence flags anomalies, missing data, and potential risks so issues are caught early—not at the last minute.

### How long does implementation take?

SMBs can typically go live in 1–2 weeks. Larger or multi-entity organizations follow a phased rollout with a dedicated implementation manager and clear country playbooks.

### How does Deel handle payroll in countries where the engine isn’t live yet?

In those countries, Deel manages payroll through local workflows and in-country experts. You only ever work with Deel—payroll results flow back into the same platform, with the same visibility, approvals, and reporting.

### Does Deel integrate with our existing systems?

Yes. Deel integrates with HR, finance, and identity systems including Workday (GPC-certified), SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, BambooHR, HiBob, Okta, and Azure AD.

### Is Deel secure?

Yes. Deel is SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliant, with role-based access controls, audit trails, and enterprise-grade security across regions.

### Can Deel scale as we grow into new countries?

Yes. Start with one country or team and expand at your own pace. Deel supports phased expansion without replatforming or vendor sprawl.
